findings_qualitative.value: Four extreme blue-shifted components C1-C4 are kinematically isolated from orbiting gas in the mini-cavity

evidence.quote: This new component is kinematically isolated from the orbiting ionized gas.

claims.hypothesis: Highly blue-shifted ionized gas exists near Sgr A* beyond the inner 1"
claims.experiment: H30a cube from ALMA Band 6 archival data
claims.result: Components C1-C4 at -366 to -455 km/s at 2-3.4" from Sgr A*
claims.finding: Highest velocity ionized gas detected beyond the inner 1"

evidence.quote: This is the highest radial velocity of ionized gas detected beyond the inner 1$''$ of Sgr A\*.

claims.experiment: Combine radial velocities with literature proper motions
claims.result: Total velocities 988 and 552 km/s vs escape ~620 km/s
claims.finding: Components likely unbound if associated with the proper-motion knots

evidence.quote: If we assume that they are associated with each other, then the total velocity implies these components are gravitationally unbound.

claims.hypothesis: A collimated outflow from Sgr A* explains the blue-shifted mini-cavity gas and red-shifted cometary sources
claims.result: Mass outflow rates of 2e-7 (jet) or 4e-5 Msun/yr (wind)
claims.finding: Jet or anisotropic wind outflow interpretation, with the jet favored

evidence.quote: An expected mass outflow rate of 2$\times10^{-7}$ or 4$\times10^{-5}$ M$_{\odot}$  yr$^{-1}$ is estimated

why_this_method.value: H30a chosen for high line-to-continuum ratio and broad velocity coverage

evidence.quote: The high sensitivity, long time baseline and broad velocity coverage observations as well as the high line-to-continuum ratio of $\sim$2 for H30$\alpha$ RL

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Collision of N and E arms rejected as the origin since the U-shaped mini-cavity is hard to explain

evidence.quote: However, the U-shaped morphology of the mini-cavity embedded in the bar is difficult to explain in this picture both spatially and kinematically.

limitations_admitted.value: Second epoch used only for detection check because of poor data quality; densities are lower limits

evidence.quote: Due to the relatively poor data quality of the second epoch, we chose to use the first (July 12/13) dataset only

referee_caveats_inferred: Unbound conclusion relies on assuming association with distant proper-motion knots
